If the second alphabet in each of the words is changed to the next alphabet in the English alphabetical
order, how many words having no vowels will be formed?

right, which of the following will be the fourth from the right?

In a certain code language, 'first of all' is written as 'kan dan san', 'who is first' is written as 'zan kan
ven', and 'this is pale' is written as 'ven gen len'. How will 'who' be written in that language?

In a row, Aman is at the 20th position from the left and Gita is at the 14th position from the right. If
they interchange their positions, Aman becomes 30th from the left. Now, what is the position of Gita from
the right?

In a row of 26 persons facing North, Person A is 13th from the right side. After shifting him third to the
left from his existing position, what is his position from the left side now?

Eight executives A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are seated around a circular table. A, C, E, and G face the
centre, while B, D, F, and H face outward (away from the centre). C sits third to the left of B. Only two
persons sit between C and F. H sits second to the right of F. D is an immediate neighbour of neither B nor
F. G sits opposite to D, and E sits immediately to the left of G. Who sits second to the left of A?

Statements: Only a few prisms are lenses. All lenses are mirrors. No mirror is a filter.
Conclusions:
I. Some prisms are not filters.
II. All prisms being mirrors is a possibility.

Statements: No granite is a marble. Some marbles are slates. All slates are schists.
Conclusions:
I. Some schists are not granites.
II. All granites being schists is a possibility.

Statements: All reactors are turbines. Some turbines are boilers. No boiler is a condenser.
Conclusions:
I. No reactor is a condenser.
II. Some reactors are condensers.
